notes.title: Final Archer VR Hot Fix
notes.content:
After the Final Archer VR was released in June, our team has made some minor hotfix to improve the gameplay experience.

1. Increase infantry health point

2. Extend hand area to load arrows

3. Minor bug fix

4. Simplify game menu ui interaction step

5. Game difficulty balancing
